column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
otel.test.ts: the model's types (type-level tests) and the values an attribute can hold
otel.test.ts: ids from given bytes, zeros refused, brands kept apart
otel.test.ts: traceparent and tracestate against the W3C examples, with property round trips
otlp.test.ts: OTLP JSON encode and decode, round-trip properties, int64 as strings, unknown fields ignored
otel.test.ts: configuration from OTEL_* records, invalid values warned and defaulted
otel.test.ts: redaction of secret attributes, URLs, tokens, name=value pairs, provider token formats
otel.test.ts: attribute, event and link limits with dropped counts
otel.test.ts: the samplers, ratio decided by the trace id alone
signals.test.ts: defineSignals, with @ts-expect-error for undeclared kinds and wrong attributes
signals.test.ts: span ends by its Result, exceptions recorded and rethrown, one end only
signals.test.ts: an exact span tree from a fixed clock and random source
signals.test.ts: in-memory, simple and batch processors, drops counted, flush bounded
signals.test.ts: counter, up-down, gauge and histogram aggregation
otel-host.test.ts: export to a local receiver, retries on 503 with Retry-After, never throws
otel-host.test.ts: the probe gives up within 150 ms, the exit wait within a second
otel-host.test.ts: the journal writes OTLP lines, rotates and removes files past their age
otel-host.test.ts: the current span across await, and the parent from TRACEPARENT
process-span.test.ts: proc spans, with traceparent passed on; the http client and serve spans are proved by commons/ts tests/runtime/otel-net.test.ts until the library net is lifted
otel-host.test.ts: the receiver decodes, refuses protobuf (415) and bad JSON (400)
the otel-conformance job runs suite/otel-conformance.test.ts against the pinned OpenTelemetry Collector and compares its file export
render.test.ts: the reducer in each mode, snapshots through the terminal emulator
render.test.ts: lines cut by display width, elapsed time and progress
render.test.ts: the export warning said once, dimmed, at the end
console.test.ts: the console is the only writer, its modes, uncaught errors recorded and rendered
render.test.ts: the pending and action marks and roles; a pending or an action is no warning
the package is built, inspected and packed by tools/pack.ts; tests/release/commons-packages.test.ts installs the tarball and runs every entry on Node 26 and Bun and type-checks a consumer
